visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers standing on a paved street in front of a grey two-story building housing 'ENRICH Daily & Brunch'. She has long brown hair and smiles at the camera before turning to walk toward the glass doors. A black Mini Cooper with a red roof is parked nearby. (2) Inside the restaurant, the scene shifts to a warmly lit interior decorated with numerous vintage-style posters and menus on a dark wall. A hand holds an orange and green printed menu on a clipboard. Close-up shots feature a Thai-style pumpkin ball dish with purple cabbage salad and an Italian oil-sealed vegetable panini. A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt is seen taking a large bite of the panini, looking impressed. (3) The scene transitions to the 'Haifu Salt Brine Tofu' shop. The woman walks toward the wooden storefront while the man flashes a peace sign. A close-up shows tofu pudding being topped with peanut powder and a square block of green matcha tofu being drizzled with red bean sauce. The woman is shown eating the matcha tofu with a gold spoon, nodding in approval. (4) Finally, the duo visits a street-side stall called 'Shuandzui Crispy Pan-fried Buns'. A man's hand holds a reusable container filled with golden-brown fried buns. The stall owner, an older man with glasses, uses tongs to arrange more buns in a glass display case. Red sauce is squeezed onto the buns. The man takes a bite of a bun, revealing a cabbage filling, followed by a cross-section of a meat-substitute filling.
